name: SeasonOnTrain Category Tree Widget for Elementor
author: jameswoo

sections.description:
SeasonOnTrain Category Tree Widget for Elementor adds a collapsible category tree widget for Elementor.
It can show nested categories, optionally expand branches by default, hide the default category,
link category names to archive pages, and optionally show related posts for leaf categories.

Usage

After adding the widget, you can configure the post type source, leaf post list, icon text or images,
default expansion, and category link behavior from the Elementor panel.

Settings

The widget includes the following options:

  • Expand All By Default
  • Post Type
  • Hide Default Category
  • Enable Category Links
  • Show Post List For Last Category
  • Leaf Post Limit
  • Expand Icon
  • Collapse Icon
  • Expand Icon Image
  • Collapse Icon Image
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Add the Category Tree widget in Elementor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. This widget is built for Elementor and requires the Elementor plugin.

Can I use SVG or image icons for expand and collapse?

Yes. You can upload SVG or image files for both icons, or use text symbols if you prefer.
